svg.aria-label: Revenue outran plan all spring, then fell behind through the summer
svg.title: Revenue outran plan all spring, then fell behind through the summer
svg.desc: Difference chart: a near-navy line is actual monthly recurring revenue, a grey line is the board plan. The band between them is shaded blue where actual runs above plan (a surplus, strongest in spring) and red where it runs below (a shortfall through the summer). Illustrative data.
svg.text: Revenue outran plan all spring, then fell behind through the summer
